text:
Sam T.: FYI — OKR draft for the next quarter is ready for exec review. Link: https://redwood/inbox/okr-q3-draft (please review by EOD tomorrow). Short list of decisions we need: prioritization across infra reliability work vs Dedicated feature set, and final launch criteria for Private deployment.

Priya R.: Thanks Sam. My high-level: reliability + predictable latency is top priority. We need Dedicated features to be backward-compatible where possible, but reliability wins if there's a tradeoff.

Ava M.: Noted. I'll reweight the objective scores. Quick question — should we move the "50% latency P90 improvement" KR from Q3 to Q4 if it requires kernel-level changes?

Diego L.: If kernel work is required, it's realistically Q4. We can do a focused P90 patch that gets 20-25% in Q3 with config/ batching improvements (less risk).

Lina K.: Sales input: several enterprise PoCs asked for Private KMS + audit logs. They said Dedicated alone isn't enough for procurement. If we defer Private launch, we risk losing two mid-market deals.

Priya R.: Lina — can you send one-pager with the two deals (ACV, must-have features)? We'll see if we can fast-track audit/KMS as a compliance sub-project.

Ava M.: Suggested tweak to OKRs: split "Private GA" into (a) "Private: KMS + audit" and (b) "Private: on-prem installer". Make (a) carry higher priority and measurable KR (KMS integrated + 2 pilot customers).

Diego L.: Tech ask: to hit (a) we need 2 sprints of ops integration + security review. I'll mark it as scoped but with a dependency on SRE capacity.

ops-bot: Reminder — company all-hands for OKR sign-off scheduled Thu 10:00am PT. Calendar invites sent.

Sam T.: Action items: 1) Ava update OKR doc with split Private GA and revised latency KR (due tomorrow noon). 2) Lina send deal one-pager (EOD). 3) Diego estimate effort for KMS integration (end of week). 4) Priya: final exec sign-off pending the doc updates. Please react with :thumbsup: when you approve.

Priya R.: I'm +1 on the direction conditional on KMS pilot for Private GA (as Ava outlined). I'll sign off after the updated doc is in.

Lina K.: Filing one-pager now.

Diego L.: I'll post a short tech estimate before EOD Fri.

Ava M.: Updating the doc now — will ping when done.

Sam T.: Great — thanks everyone. If no major objections after updates, we'll call this approved at Thu all-hands. :white_check_mark:
